name: Deworming: the END Fund (SoGive, 2022)
beneficiaries_note: The locations the sheet's bottom line reads (row labels naming Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Angola, Rwanda, Zimbabwe), sharing equally.
summary: The END Fund funds and supports mass deworming for schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted worms across sub-Saharan Africa. SoGive's deworming cost-effectiveness analysis (August 2022): GiveWell's 2022 model with SoGive's own, much lower, replicability adjustment for the long-term income gains of deworming. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line for the END Fund; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.
